caption:
Nobody warns you about these until it's too late.

No tax comes out of ABN payments, so year one's tax arrives in one hit. Then the ATO may put you on quarterly instalments for the next year, on top. Hit $75K turnover and you must register for GST. And nobody pays your super but you.

Send this to the mate who just went out on their own.

Comment ABN and you'll be first to get the Starter Kit when it lands in December.

General info only, not personal advice.

#soletrader #newbusiness #abn #smallbusinessaustralia #sidehustle
